40018732.author: पदार्थः
40018732.content: तदा then, तेनकाकुत्स्थेन by Kakuthsa, क्रोधात् in anger, रणे in the war, आर्दितःpained, समरश्लाघि: proud of skill in warfare, सःतुरावणःhe Ravana, महाक्रोधम् very angry, उपागमत् became

40018732.author: Translation
40018732.content: Ravana, who was proud of his skill in warfare, became very angry when he was pained by Kakuthsa's arrows.

40018733.author: पदार्थः
40018733.content: वीर्यवान् valiant one, वीरः hero, सः he, अमर्षात् bearing, दीप्तनयनः flaming eyes, राघवम् Raghava, सुसङ्क्रुद्ध: very angry, रोषात् furiously, चापम् bow, अपयाम्य fixing, अम्बरात् sky, सः he, तोयदःइव like water, तटाकम् इव like tank, बाणधारासहस्रैः thousands of arrows showered, राघवम् Raghava, पूरयन् fill, अभ्यर्दयत् covered

40018733.author: Translation
40018733.content: Valiant hero, Ravana, with his eyes flaming in anger, raising his bow, rained arrows at Sri Rama. He continued to rain thousands of arrows just as rain filled the tank, his arrows covered Raghava.

40018734.author: पदार्थः
40018734.content: वीर्यवान् valiant one, वीरः hero, सः he, अमर्षात् bearing, दीप्तनयनः flaming eyes, राघवम् Raghava, सुसङ्क्रुद्ध: very angry, रोषात् furiously, चापम् bow, अपयाम्य fixing, अम्बरात् sky, सः he, तोयदःइव like water, तटाकम् इव like tank, बाणधारासहस्रैः thousands of arrows showered, राघवम् Raghava, पूरयन् fill, अभ्यर्दयत् covered

40018734.author: Translation
40018734.content: Valiant hero, Ravana, with his eyes flaming in anger, raising his bow, rained arrows at Sri Rama. He continued to rain thousands of arrows just as rain filled the tank, his arrows covered Raghava.

40018735.author: पदार्थः
40018735.content: सम्युगे in the conflict, धनुर्मुक्तेन released from the bow, शरजालेन network of arrows, पूरितःcovered, काकुस्त्थ: Kakuthsa, अकम्प्यः not shaken, महागिरिरिव like a huge mountain, न प्रकम्पते not agitated

40018735.author: Translation
40018735.content: Sri Rama did not get agitated, and stood like a huge mountain, even though the network of arrows released from the bow of Ravana covered him in the conflict.

40018736.author: पदार्थः
40018736.content: वीर्यवान् valiant, सः he, समरे in war, स्थितः stood, शरैः arrows, शरजालानि streams of arrows, वारयन् intercepting, सूर्यस्य sun's, गभस्तीनिव like rays, प्रतिजग्राह tolerated

40018736.author: Translation
40018736.content: Valiant Sri Rama stood intercepting them when streams of arrows covered him, and tolerated them like the rays of the Sun.

40018737.author: पदार्थः
40018737.content: ततः thereafter, क्षिप्रहस्तः quickhanded, निशाचरः night ranger, क्रुद्धः angry, महात्मनः great soul, राघवस्य Raghava's, उरसि chest, शरसहस्राणि thousands of arrows, निजघान struck

40018737.author: Translation
40018737.content: Thereafter the quickhanded angry night ranger struck into the chest of Raghava thousands of arrows.

40018738.author: पदार्थः
40018738.content: समरे in the conflict, शोणितसमादिग्धः covered with blood all over, लक्ष्मणाग्रजः Lakshmana's elder brother, अरण्ये in the forest, फुल्लः in bloom, सुमहान् huge, किंशुकद्रुमः Kimsuka tree, दृष्टः looked

40018738.author: Translation
40018738.content: In that conflict Lakshmana's elder brother looked like a huge Kimsuka tree in bloom in the forest body being covered with blood all over.

40018739.author: पदार्थः
40018739.content: शराभिघातसम्रब्दः angered by the impact of arrows, सुमहातेजाः highly energetic, सःकाकुत्स्थ: that Kakuthsa, युगान्तादित्यतेजसः like the sun blazing at the end of dissolution of the universe, सायकान् shafts, अभिजग्राह took up

40018739.author: Translation
40018739.content: Endowed with extraordinary energy, Kakuthsa, angered by the impact of arrows resembled the Sun at the end of universal dissolution, took up arrows.

40018740.author: पदार्थः
40018740.content: ततः then, सुसम्रब्धौ speedily releasing arrows, तौ those, उभौ both, रामरावणौ Rama and Ravana, तदा then, शरान्धकारे darkened by the arrows, समरे in the battlefield, अन्योन्यम् one another, नोपलक्ष्यताम् not able to see

40018740.author: Translation
40018740.content: Then with both Rama and Ravana speedily releasing (hail of) arrows on one another, the battlefield was darkened by arrows, and they were not able to see each other.

40018741.author: पदार्थः
40018741.content: ततः then, दशरथात्मजः Dasharatha's son, वीरः heroic, रामः Rama, क्रोधसमाविष्टः overcome by anger, प्रहस्य laughing, रावणम् at Ravana, परुषम् harsh, वचः words, उवाच spoke

40018741.author: Translation
40018741.content: Then Rama, the heroic son of Dasharatha, overcome by anger, laughing at Ravana, spoke these words.

40018742.author: पदार्थः
40018742.content: राक्षसाधम lowly Rakshasa, विवशा helpless, ममभार्या my wife, यस्मात् therefore, अज्ञानात् ignorantly, ते you, हृता abducted, तस्मात् therefore, त्वम् you, वीर्यवन् valiant, नासि not

40018742.author: Translation
40018742.content: "Lowly Rakshasa! My wife was abducted by you ignorantly when she was helpless. Therefore, you are not valiant."

40018743.author: पदार्थः
40018743.content: मया from me, विरहिताम् separated, दीनाम् desperate, महावने in the great forest, वर्तमानाम् living, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, प्रसभम् forcibly, हृत्वा abducted, अहम् I, शूरः hero, इति thus, मन्यसे you think

40018743.author: Translation
40018743.content: "Having abducted Vaidehi living in the forest by force, when she was desperate and separated from me, do you think that you are a hero?

40018744.author: पदार्थः
40018744.content: विनाथासु timid fellow, स्त्रीषु women, शूर hero, परदाराभिमर्शक laying hands on other woman, कापुरुषम् such men, कर्म action, कृत्वा having done, अहम् I, शूरःhero, इति thus, मन्यसे thinking

40018744.author: Translation
40018744.content: "Timid fellow! You having laid hands on another woman think you are a hero? You, who have done such an action, think that you are a hero?"

40018745.author: पदार्थः
40018745.content: भिन्नमर्याद transgressed morality, निर्लज्ज shameless, चारित्रे traditional practice, अनवस्थित dissolute, दर्पात् pride, मृत्युम् death, उपादाय seeking, अहम् I, शूरः heroic, इति thus, मन्यसे think

40018745.author: Translation
40018745.content: "O shameless one! You have transgressed morality and traditional practice. You are dissolute and by your pride seeking death. You think that you are a hero!"

40018746.author: पदार्थः
40018746.content: शूरेण hero, धनदभ्रात्रा brother of Kubera, बलैः rich in might, समुदितेन च and risen up, त्वया by you, श्लाघनीयम् laudable, यशस्यं च attained fame, महत् great, कर्म action, कृतम् performed

40018746.author: Translation
40018746.content: "By laudable great action performed by you (of abducting Sita and your penance) you have attained fame. You are a heroic brother of Kubera, rich in might."

40018747.author: पदार्थः
40018747.content: उत्सेकेन out of pride, अभिपन्नस्य overpowered, गर्हितस्य vanity, अहितस्य च hurtful, तस्यकर्मणः your action, सुमहत् great, फलम् result, अद्य today, इदानीम् this way, प्राप्नुहि attained

40018747.author: Translation
40018747.content: "You will attain the great result of your hurtful action, overpowered by pride and vanity today."

40018748.author: पदार्थः
40018748.content: दुर्मते evil minded, आत्मानम् yourself, अहम् I, शूरःhero, इति thus, अवगच्छसि praise, चौरवत् like a thief, सीताम् Sita, व्यपकर्षतः abducting, ते to you, लज्जा shame, नैवअस्ति not stand

40018748.author: Translation
40018748.content: "O Evil minded fellow! You boast yourself as a hero, while you abducted Sita like a thief. Shame did not stand in your way."

40018749.author: पदार्थः
40018749.content: सीता Sita, त्वया by you, मत्सन्निधौ my presence, बलात् forcibly, धर्षिता taken, स्याद्यदि been seen, तदा then, मत्सायकैः by my arrows, हतः killed, भ्रातरम् brother, खरम् Khara, पश्येः seen

40018749.author: Translation
40018749.content: "If Sita had been seen by me forcibly taken by you in my presence, then you would have been killed by my arrows and seen your brother Khara."

40018750.author: पदार्थः
40018750.content: दुष्टात्मन् selfish, दिष्ट्या seen now, मम by me, चक्षुर्विषयम् in my sight, आगतःअसि have come now, अद्य today, त्वाम् you, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, सायकैः by arrows, यमसादनम् abode of Yama, नयामि reach

40018750.author: Translation
40018750.content: "O selfish Ravana! Today you have come in my sight by good fortune. I shall send you to the abode of Yama with my arrows."

40018751.author: पदार्थः
40018751.content: अद्य now, मच्छरैः by my shafts, छिन्नम् severed, रणपांसुषु in the battlefield, विकीर्णम् covered with dust, ज्वलितकुण्डलम् shining earrings, तेशिरः your head, क्रन्यादाः carnivorous animals, व्यपकर्षन्तु be dragged

40018751.author: Translation
40018751.content: "Now, let your head severed by my shafts lying in dust in the battlefield with the shining earrings be dragged by the carnivorous animals."

40018752.author: पदार्थः
40018752.content: रावण Ravana, क्षितौ caused to destroy, क्षिप्तस्य scattered, ते your, उरसि chest, निपत्य fallen, गृध्राः vultures, बाणशल्यान्तरोत्थितम् by the piercing of the heads of my arrows, रुधिरम् blood, पिबन्तु drink

40018752.author: Translation
40018752.content: "Ravana! After your body is caused to destroy and scattered on the ground, let the vultures drink the blood oozing from your chest pierced by the heads of my arrows."

40018753.author: पदार्थः
40018753.content: अद्य now, मद्बाणभिन्नस्य by my arrows splitting, गतासोः ceased of life, पतितस्य fallen, ते your, अन्त्राणि intestines, पतगाः birds, गरुत्मन्तः eagles, उरगानिव like snakes, कर्षन्तु dragging

40018753.author: Translation
40018753.content: "Let the birds tear your intestines as eagles would tear off snakes, now when your body is split and fallen, split by my arrows and ceased of life."

40018754.author: पदार्थः
40018754.content: वीरः hero, शत्रुनिबर्हणः exterminator of enemies, रामः Rama, इत्येवम् in this way, वदन् speaking, समीपस्थम् nearby, राक्षसेन्द्रम् king of Rakshasas, शरवर्षैः rained arrows, अवाकिरत् covered

40018754.author: Translation
40018754.content: Speaking in this way to Ravana who was nearby, Rama the exterminator of enemies rained showers of arrows and covered.

40018755.author: पदार्थः
40018755.content: संयुगे in battle, शत्रोः enemy, निधनकाङ्क्षिणः desirous of destruction, रामस्य Rama's, वीर्यम् valiance, बलम् strength, हर्षश्च enthusiasm, अस्त्रबलंचैव and strength of missiles, द्विगुणम् doubled, बभूव became

40018755.author: Translation
40018755.content: The strength, valiance, enthusiasm, and the strength of missiles of Rama, who was desirous of the destruction of the enemy, doubled.

40018756.author: पदार्थः
40018756.content: विदितात्मनः rich in selfknowledge, सर्वाणि all, अस्त्राणि missiles, प्रादुर्भभूवुः appeared before him, महातेजाः excessive energy, प्रहर्षात् joy, शीघ्रहस्ततरः skillful with hands अभूत् became

40018756.author: Translation
40018756.content: All missiles appeared before Rama because of his richness in selfknowledge. In his excessive energy and joy the prince became more skillful with his hands.

40018757.author: पदार्थः
40018757.content: राक्षसान्तकृत् one who can put an end to Rakshasas, सःरामः that Rama, आत्मगतानि his own past, शुभानि auspicious, एतानि all these, चिह्नानि signs, विज्ञाय knowing, रावणम् Ravana, भूयःएव more vehemently, अर्दयत् strike

40018757.author: Translation
40018757.content: Rama, who can put an end to Rakshasas, knower of his own self having experienced auspicious signs, began to strike at Ravana more vehemently.

40018758.author: पदार्थः
40018758.content: हरीणाम् Vanaras, अश्मनिकरैः stones from their hands, राघवात् at Raghava, शरवर्षाच्च rain of shafts, हन्यमानः pained, दशग्रीवः ten headed, विघूर्णहृदयः bewildered, अभवत् became

40018758.author: Translation
40018758.content: By the stones thrown by the Vanaras and rain of shafts from Raghava, the ten headed Ravana was pained and was bewildered.

40018759.author: पदार्थः
40018759.content: यदा like that, शस्त्रम् missiles, नारेभे not started, शरासनम् arrows, न चकर्ष not able to stretch bow, विक्लबेन confused, अन्तरात्मना mentally, अस्य his, वीर्यम् valiance, न प्रत्यकरोत् not oppose

40018759.author: Translation
40018759.content: Being confused mentally, Ravana did not start his arrows, nor stretch his bow, nor was able to use missiles and was not able to oppose Rama's valour.

40018760.author: पदार्थः
40018760.content: तेन by the, क्षिप्ताः destroyed, शराः arrows, विविधानि several, शस्त्राणि च missiles, मरणार्थाय death as objective, वर्तन्ते unable to act, मृत्युकालः time of death, अभ्यवर्ततunable to do

40018760.author: Translation
40018760.content: Ravana's arrows of several kinds being destroyed, perceiving that his death is objective Rama's missiles, and that the time of death appeared, he was unable to act.

40018761.author: पदार्थः
40018761.content: अस्य his, रथनेता charioteer, सूतस्तु Sutha, तदवस्थम् that condition, तम् him, निरीक्ष्य observing, असम्भ्रान्तः quietly, शनैः slowly, तस्य his, रथम् chariot, युद्धात् from the battlefield, अपवाहयत् withdrew

40018761.author: Translation
40018761.content: Observing his (Ravana's) condition, the charioteer quietly, slowly withdrew his chariot from the battlefield.
